faqs.q: How do I get my key after purchase?
faqs.a: After payment, open My Orders for delivered orders and copy the key; or use Order Lookup with your order number. Keys are cached in Redis for 24 hours.

faqs.q: Can I look up orders without signing in?
faqs.a: Yes — use Order Lookup with the full order number. Viewing keys requires a delivered order on your signed-in account.
Mock payment by default for testing; configure Alipay and WeChat (including JSAPI) in admin for production.
Yes — enter a coupon code on checkout; the pricing engine applies the best promotion and coupon price.

faqs.q: How do I redeem an existing key?
faqs.a: Use the Redeem page with key and user ID; third parties can call POST /api/v1/redeem.

faqs.q: How do I integrate third-party systems?
faqs.a: Webhook redeem callbacks (HMAC signed), API clients and standard REST redeem API.

faqs.q: Can the same key be sold twice?
faqs.a: No — unique keys are generated in a transaction; callbacks use optimistic locking against duplicate delivery.

faqs.q: How do I deploy my own shop?
faqs.a: Docker Compose one-click, or build the JAR and serve the frontend with Nginx. See README.
